purpose: Project the same FIELD identity/state/operation at different information densities without inventing separate mobile/desktop semantics.

ladder.MARK: Glyph/mark only. Identity is available through target/title/aria or reveal; no prose required.
ladder.COMPACT: Glyph + short identity + only decision-relevant metadata.
ladder.FULL: Glyph + identity + provenance/state/role/details where space and task justify them.

laws: DENSITY IS A PROJECTION, NOT A DIFFERENT OBJECT.
AVAILABLE SPACE MAY CHANGE REPRESENTATION; IT MAY NOT CHANGE IDENTITY, STATE, AUTHORITY OR ORDER.
MARK MUST ROUND-TRIP TO THE SAME TARGET AS FULL.
TEXT IS REVEALABLE RESIDUE, NOT A PERMANENT TAX ON SCREEN AREA.
SEMANTIC MARKS COMPOSE FROM KIND × OPERATION × STATE × ATTENTION; decorative uniqueness is not a glyph law.
MOBILE/DESKTOP ARE IMPLEMENTATION CONDITIONS, NOT SEPARATE INTERFACE ONTOLOGIES.
next_adoption_rule: Adopt on another surface only when it removes duplicated responsive/presentation logic without erasing that surface's distinct interaction identity.
